commandants.name: Rear Admiral GA Shiyanbade
commandants.title: DSS psc(+) mni
commandants.description: He served as an engineer officer in various staff capacities until 1983 when he was appointed on board the Nation’s Flagship, NNS ARADU as WEO. He was promoted Cdr in 1984. He is a graduate of the Command and Staff College Course 7 (1984/85) and on completion, was reappointed for a second tour of duty on board NNS ARADU as WEO. Between 1986 and 1990 he was Commander, Nigerian Navy Technical Centre (NNTTC) NNS, URHIAPELE, Sapele and Director of Ships Spares Procurement at NHQ. He was promoted Captain in January, 1988 and served between 1990 and 1992 at the NDA, Kaduna as the Director of Administration. He was Captain in charge of Technical Training at the HQ, Naval Training Command, Lagos. He was promoted to the rank of Commodore in December 1993
commandants.bio_summary: On his return to the Nigerian Navy in October 1975, he served as Assistant Weapons and Electrical Officer (AWEO) on board NNS NIGERIA between 1976 and 1978. During this period, the ship undertook a refit and systems upgrading programme at the ship builder’s yard in Holland. Rear Admiral Shiyanbade proceeded to Holland on a 9 months Naval Weapons Control System Course and thereafter was appointed a member of the NN Inspection Delegation to oversee the construction and outfitting of 2 new MK-9 Corvette Frigate Warships at the Vosper Thornycroft Shipyards, in Portsmouth, England. He was promoted Lt Cdr in 1978 and appointed the first Weapons Electrical Officer (WEO) of one of the newly commissioned frigates, NNS ERIN-OMI.
commandants.biography_full: He served as an engineer officer in various staff capacities until 1983 when he was appointed on board the Nation’s Flagship, NNS ARADU as WEO. He was promoted Cdr in 1984. He is a graduate of the Command and Staff College Course 7 (1984/85) and on completion, was reappointed for a second tour of duty on board NNS ARADU as WEO. Between 1986 and 1990 he was Commander, Nigerian Navy Technical Centre (NNTTC) NNS, URHIAPELE, Sapele and Director of Ships Spares Procurement at NHQ. He was promoted Captain in January, 1988 and served between 1990 and 1992 at the NDA, Kaduna as the Director of Administration. He was Captain in charge of Technical Training at the HQ, Naval Training Command, Lagos. He was promoted to the rank of Commodore in December 1993
training: graduate fellow of the National War College (fwc) Course-2 (93/94), Rear Admiral Shiyanbade was later appointed as Commander Fleet Support Group (FSG), Western Naval Command in 1994, Commander Fleet Maintenance Corps (FMC), Nigerian Navy, Jul-95 and Commodore Superintendent NN Shipyard Port-Harcourt July 95 - January 97 before his appointment to the College as Deputy Commandant and Director of Studies between 14 January 97 and 2 September 1998. He was promoted to the rank of Rear Admiral in February 1998 and appointed Chief of Logistics at Naval Headquarters between 3 September 1998 and 3 August 1999. He is currently the Commandant of National War College (since August 1999) and the first alumnus of the College to hold the post. Rear Admiral Shiyanbade is a member of many professional bodies such as the Nigerian Society of Engineers (MNSE), and the Nigerian Institute of Management (MNIM); he is also a registered Chartered Engineer (COREN).
commandants.family_note: Rear Admiral Shiyanbade is married with 3 children, 2 girls and 1 boy. His wife Sanda, was born in Mumbai or Bombay, India and is a Nurse by profession. Rear Admiral Shiyanbade enjoys playing table tennis, squash rackets and an occasional game of golf but his main hobbies are photography and reading.

commandants.name: Rear Admiral A Ahmed
commandants.title: GSS psc(+)afwc +fnwc(+)fdc(+)SCHOLAR
commandants.description:
Rear Admiral Abdullahi Ahmed has taken over as the 22nd Commandant of the National Defence College (NDC), Nigeria. Rear Admiral Abdullahi Ahmed is a highly decorated senior officer in the Nigerian Navy. His appointment follows a large-scale redeployment of 65 senior officers in the Nigerian Navy, aimed at boosting operational efficiency and enhancing maritime security. As Commandant, Rear Admiral Ahmed will oversee advanced leadership training and strategic courses for senior officers. He brings over three decades of experience to his new role, having held various key positions in the Nigerian Navy, including Directing Staff at the National Defence College, Air Force War College, and Armed Forces Command and Staff College.

Rear Admiral Abdullahi Ahmed education includes degrees in Biological Sciences. He is a Chevening Scholar with a Master’s degree in International Affairs from the University of Ghana and another in International Security Studies from the University of Leicester, UK. He also completed a program in International Cyber Policy.

Throughout his career, Rear Admiral Ahmed has held significant positions. Some of his notable past roles include:

– Deputy Chief of Defence Space Administration.

– Director of Recruitment, Resettlement, and Reserve at Naval Headquarters.

– Director of Plans at Naval Headquarters.

– Commander, Nigerian Navy Ship PATHFINDER.

– Commander, Naval Unit Abuja.

– 7th Commandant, the Naval War College, Nigeria.

His professional honors include the Grand Service Star (GSS), Pass Staff College Dagger (psc+), and the Chief of Naval Staff Commendation. Rear Admiral Ahmed is married with children.

Rear Admiral Abdullahi’s assumption of duty as Commandant of the National Defence College Nigeria is expected to further strengthen the NDC’s position as Nigeria’s apex institution for defence and strategic studies, fostering excellence in leadership, research, and national security management.
commandants.bio_summary: Rear Admiral Abdullahi Ahmed is the 22nd Commandant of the National Defence College Nigeria. The Commandant is a highly decorated senior officer in the Nigerian Navy. By that position, he oversees advanced leadership training for senior officers of the Armed Forces of Nigeria, allied countries, Ministries, Departments and Agencies. He brings over three decades of experience to his role, having held various key positions in the Nigerian Navy, including Directing Staff at the same National Defence College, Air Force War College, and Armed Forces Command and Staff College.
